AGENDA
  ITEM 6.A.

  YOUTH COMMITTEE

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  Thursday, November 20, 2025

1. CALL TO ORDER

  Chair J. Lee call the November 20, 2025 Youth Committee Meeting to order at
  5:34 p.m.

2. ROLL CALL – Committee Members

  PRESENT:  Committee Member – Cadavid, J. Guo, S. Guo, D. Lam,
  E. Lam, A. Lee, J. Lee, Sriram, Wong, Yu, Zhang
  (arrived at 5:38 p.m.)

  ABSENT:  Committee Member – Chau

  ALSO PRESENT: Councilmember Chavez, City Manager Cook, City
  Clerk Kuo, and Deputy City Clerk Flores.

  Committee Member A. Lee made a motion to excuse Committee
  Member Chau and Committee Member Zhang. Seconded by Committee
  J. Lee.

3. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Chair J. Lee lead the Pledge of Allegiance.

4. PRESENTATIONS- None.

5. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA- None

6. CONSENT CALENDAR

  A.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The Youth Committee is requested to review and approve the Minutes of
  the Regular Committee Meeting of September 29, 2025.

  Recommendation:  Approved.

7. NEW BUSINESS

  A. TRANSPORTATION  AND  PUBLIC  SAFETY  COMMISSION  MEETING
  UPDATE
 Youth Committee Minutes

  No update.

  B. PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION MEETING UPDATE

  Committee Member D. Lam provided an update on the Parks and
  Recreation commission meeting in October. Staff reported that the city
  received positive feedback for the new Live Oak Park playground, they are
  preparing for the October Trunk-O-Treat, and that staff will recommend
  installing a concrete pathway for those waiting to use the highly utilized
  pickleball courts.

  Committee member Wong made a motion to receive and file the update.
  Seconded by Committee Member E. Lam.

  C. PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING UPDATE

  Committee Member Sriram provided an update on the Planning
  Commission meeting in October. Staff reported that they will bring an
  annual code amendment to the City Council to comply with State Law.

  Committee Member L. Addison made a motion to receive and file the
  update. Seconded by Committee Member Cadavid.

  8. COMMUNICATIONS FROM COUNCILMEMBER CHAVEZ

  Councilmember Chavez talked about the City Commissions and the
  business they conduct. He provided a recap of the Halloween event at
  Live Oak parks and the Veterans Day event at Temple City Park. He also
  shared that City Council adopted resolutions calling for the City's
  General Municipal Election on March 3, 2026.  There will be two
  Councilmember seats to fill and a sales tax measure for the voters to
  vote on (the current sales tax rate is 9.75% and the measure is proposing
  to increase the sales tax rate by 3/4 % (i.e., 10.5%)). He also shared that
  Youth Committee members Jessica and Sophia Guo were selected as
  student ambassadors for the Sister City's Student Exchange Program to
  Australia. Lastly, he shared that City of Carmel by the Sea has banned
  pickleball courts in their city possibly due to the noise.

  9. COMMUNICATIONS FROM STAFF

  A. UPCOMING CITY EVENTS

  Deputy City Clerk Flores informed the committee members that they
  will be marching in the Lights on Temple City Parade only. The
  committee will not have a booth for the event this year. She also
  shared that the committee will be given a tour of city hall after the

  meeting. She reminded the committee members of the upcoming
  city commissions and Youth Committee meetings, the Youth
  Committee Friendsmas in December, and she encouraged the
  committee members to visit the Homestead Museum to learn more
  about the City's founders.

  B. COUNCIL AND YOUTH COMMITTEE MIXER

  Deputy City Clerk Flores shared that staff would work on scheduling a
  date with councilmembers. More details will be provided at a future
  meeting.

  C. YOUTH COMMITTEE ENGAGEMENT SERIES

  Deputy City Clerk Flores talked about the committee's tour of the
  Temple Sheriff Station.

  Staff will work on scheduling a date for the committee to meet with the
  Community Development Department to learn about new legislations
  that may have an impact on the city.

  D. COMMISSION MEETINGS

  Deputy City Clerk Flores announced upcoming city commission meeting
  dates.

  E. YOUTH COMMITTEE MONTHLY MEETING

  Deputy City Clerk Flores reminded the members of the upcoming bi-
  monthly meeting on January 22, 2026 at 5:30 p.m.

  10. YOUTH COMMITTEE MEMBER ITEMS SEPARATE FROM THE REGULAR
  AGENDA

  Committee member J. Lee commented that the corner of Lemon Avenue
  and Temple City Boulevard floods during the rain. Committee member A.
  Lee asked if the high school track can be open to the residents at night.
  Committee member J. Guo asked about the Youth Committee's self-guided
  tour project from last year.

  11. PUBLIC COMMENTS -- None

  12. ADJOURNMENT

  The November 20, 2025 Youth Committee meeting is adjourn at 6:00 p.m.
